hook.say: How well do you know Asia, the biggest continent on Earth? Five questions, three seconds each!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: In which country is the Taj Mahal?
questions.fact: Emperor Shah Jahan built it as a tomb for his wife, Mumtaz Mahal.
questions.sayAnswer: India! Emperor Shah Jahan built it as a tomb for his wife, Mumtaz Mahal.

questions.q: What is the highest mountain in Japan?
questions.fact: Mount Fuji is 3,776 meters high and last erupted in 1707.
questions.sayAnswer: Mount Fuji! It is 3,776 meters high, and it last erupted in 1707.

questions.q: Which city was called Edo until 1868?
questions.fact: The new name, Tokyo, simply means Eastern Capital.
questions.sayAnswer: Tokyo! The new name simply means Eastern Capital.

questions.q: The Gobi Desert stretches across which two countries?
questions.fact: The Gobi is a cold desert. Frost and even snow can cover its dunes.
questions.sayAnswer: China and Mongolia! The Gobi is a cold desert. Frost and even snow can cover its dunes.

questions.q: Which is the only landlocked country in Southeast Asia?
questions.fact: Laos is boxed in by China, Vietnam, Cambodia, Thailand and Myanmar.
questions.sayAnswer: Laos! It is boxed in by China, Vietnam, Cambodia, Thailand and Myanmar.
